head: e9b3106
summary: Implemented four discovered AI routes, the 37-declaration capability boundary, trusted page/chat assembly, strict numeral integrity and twelve exact prompt/publication contracts. Whole-solution build and formatting pass; all 1,025 fast tests pass, including 213 owned AI tests. Final compiled-host semantic replay is 5/23 AI cases passing (21.74%), below 95%; required sibling projections/commands remain absent and are explicitly inventoried. Production Foundry publication/invocation remains unverified. Changes are local and restricted to owned paths.

deviations.what: Offline chat renders authorized canonical blocks or explicit dependency refusals instead of the recording's fixed demonstration.
deviations.why: Unrelated demonstration figures are not a valid answer about the selected client; no calculated fact is changed.

deviations.what: Client summaries read the inward Gold port instead of reproducing the Python router-default SQL binding error.
deviations.why: The intended read works with concrete application arguments; provider exceptions are sanitized.

deviations.what: These routes use a keyed request-scoped instance of the existing mediator and explicit feature-local forwarding registrations.
deviations.why: The shared singleton captured request collaborators at root scope, and unconditional application scanning registered optional handlers without their feature services. Both issues were corrected entirely in owned paths.

deviations.what: Validation English/context and SSE charset spelling are not reproduced byte for byte.
deviations.why: The approved policy excludes framework and wire artifacts; error families, statuses, validation locations and stream semantics are preserved. The improvements register records the exact scopes.

findings: The roster, prompt files and captured publication requests each number twelve; manifest metadata is not another agent. Current ChannelNarratorAgent is version four.
The catalogue's implemented flags preserve the Python declarations; they are not proof that missing sibling production bridges are installed.
Final raw replay completed all 36 exchanges: 192 differences, six tolerated; AI five of 23 passing. The replay gate is not claimed.

Missing book_rank and client_eligibility projections, portfolio/unit/employee page projections and sibling setup handlers block replay success. They are never replaced with recordings or invented zeroes.
The unchanged replay-board wrapper explicitly applies no improvements waivers. Removing incidental differences would still not satisfy missing production contracts.

Strict numeric integrity and page-summary written-precision checking are distinct. Portal chat's model prose remains unchecked numerically, as in the documented Python path; no W3 composer or ledger is claimed.
Employee summaries are deterministic, and person-only capability facts and unit person lines are withheld from models.
The production Foundry SDK/factory is still absent; verified fake publication DTOs are not deployed agents or live invocation evidence.
Whole fast tests passed 1,025 cases with no failures or skips; the final prompt-registration build, 279 API regressions and full formatting also passed.
No live Fabric, Foundry, Entra or customer system, remote change, push or unowned product edit was used. Temporary replay hosts were stopped.
